I'm a Humanitarian: Has a bunch of human body parts stored in containers and marinating in his fridge, with the obvious intention of eating them.

characters.name: As a Whole
characters.description: Childhood Friends: They have known each other since they were teenagers and have some special bond because of their long history. Cold-Blooded Torture: The women they capture are subjected to unspeakable acts of violence and the immense level of pain. They're confined and repeatedly beaten and raped by them. Creepy Souvenir: Boyd, the killer of the women and the last link in the chain, keeps numbered strands of their blonde hair. Another member took a piece of their jewelry. A third made videos of torturing and raping them and kept the numberedDVDs, and finally, their leader Jordan Chase has a vial with the blood of their first victim. Hate Sink: You don't get any more hideous and hateable than beingSerial Rapistswho not any are remorseless about the act, but actively enjoy doing them. These guys are made out to be as loathsome as possible, which is evident when Dexter himself is disgusted by their actions. Lack of Empathy: So much that evenDexteris sickened by their actions.

characters.name: Jordan Chase (AKA: Eugene Greer)
characters.description: A charismatic and popular motivational speaker, known for his 'Take It!' approach to life. He's also a demented sociopath and ringleader of the Barrel Girl Gang. Big Bad: Of Season 5. His cult's brutal rape and torture of Lumen ultimately sets in motion the conflict that underlies the season's plot. Catchphrase: He has two phrases he's fond of repeating: "Tick, tick, tick. That's the sound of your life running out." and "Take it!" Used in his motivational speeches and business, and also creepily when he's 'coaching' his mates to torture, rape and murder. The Chessmaster: Easily able to manipulate people into serving his interests - he's shown and noted, in-universe, to have a knack for getting into people's heads and getting what he wants out of them. This can be seen most clearly in his relationship with Emily Birch (whom he manipulated into thinking they have a "bond" and helping him despite his horrible crimes against her) and his actions after learning of Dexter and Lumen'sRoaring Rampage of Revenge, when he manipulates the two of them and the police against each other, even "sacrificing a pawn" (by snitching on one of his cohorts) for it like he's playing chess. Control Freak: He must absolutely keep control of a situation at all times, and he freaks out pretty viciously when anything goes wrong.

characters.name: Cole Harmon
characters.description: The loyal head of security for Jordan Chase. Asshole Victim: A sadistic serial rapist and torturer, his death garners little sympathy. Badass in a Nice Suit: He's a former marine who can go toe-to-toe with Dexter and always wears a sharp suit. Cold-Blooded Torture: It was his fetish when hurting Lumen. Defiant to the End: He spits insults at Dexter and Lumen when they try to interrogate him.

characters.name: Boyd Fowler
characters.description: The 'cleaner' for the Barrel Girl Gang, he works in dead animal pick-up and is responsible for disposing of the gang's victims. Asshole Victim: Despite his claims of mercy to his victims, he raped, tortured, and murdered a dozen young women. Bitch in Sheep's Clothing: He's pretty affable and cool until his whole murder, rape and torture hobby is revealed. Clean Up Crew: His role within the Group. Boyd kills the victims and disposes of them in barrels. Crouching Moron, Hidden Badass: Dexter underestimates him, thinking of him as just an ill-educated victim. He's not.

characters.name: Dan Mendell AKA "Dan the Dentist"
characters.description: A dentist and scout for the group. Alliterative Name: Not actually, but once it's revealed he's a dentist, Dexter, Lumen, and Debra all call him "Dan the Dentist." Asshole Victim: A serial rapist who dies in the middle of calling one of his victims a cunt. Bait the Dog: Dexter actually believes for a while that he might be innocent and Lumen attacked him for no reason. Then he gets his hands on Lumen's phone and immediately calls his accomplices to warn them. Depraved Dentist: He's a member of murderous gang and a serial rapist, and a dentist in his everyday life.

characters.name: Alex Tilden
characters.description: A banker and weak-willed flunky of Jordan Chase. Affair Jewelry: A horrible variant, since he collects jewelry from the women he raped and murdered, though he also collects jewelry from Lumen, who he raped but did not kill. Ain't Too Proud to Beg: He begs and cries for his life. Asshole Victim: For all his insistence that Jordan pushed him into it, he nevertheless took part in the torture, rape and murder of young women. Buy Them Off: Part ofAin't Too Proud to Beginvolves saying gimme a number and it's yours (since he is a banker and can get a lot of money). Lumen and Dexter are not having any of it.

characters.name: Emily Birch
characters.description: The first victim of Jordan Chase and the rest of the group. She's been kept alive by Jordan, living a solitary, damaged existence while still manipulated by Jordan. The Alcoholic: She has a history of drunk driving. Broken Bird: She lives alone, drunk and submissive and eager to please Jordan. Disposable Woman: She is killed the episode after she appears for the first time. Rape as Backstory: She was gang-raped at Jordan's command when she was a camp counselor.

characters.name: Travis Marshall
characters.description: A student of Professor James Gellar and his serial killer protege. It's later revealed that he has aSplit Personalityand Gellar has been in his mind the entire time, representing his 'Dark Passenger'. Anti-Villain: Played with and ultimately subverted. At first, he merely appears to be a weak-willed individual who’s being pressured by his former professor, James Gellar, into performing ritualistic sacrifices under the belief they are demanded by God. However, Gellar is ultimately revealed to be a product of Travis's subconscious embodying narcissistic and violent personality traits exhibited by him since childhood. Ax-Crazy: May not be the most evil Dexter villain, but is definitely the most insane. Bastard Understudy: Played straight at first, when he seems to be doing the bidding of Gellar. Eventually it's revealed that he was solo the whole time. Big Bad: The main antagonist of Season 6.

characters.name: Professor James Gellar
characters.description: A Professor of Religious Studies believed to be the dominant Doomsday Killer. He’s later revealed to have beenDead All Along, murdered by his student Travis and kept in a freezer below an abandoned church. However, he continues to play a role in the Sixth Season as the personification of Travis Marshall's Dark Passenger. Dead All Along: Revealed as such in 'Get Gellar'. Dirty Old Man: Had a habit of sleeping with younger women. Evil Counterpart: To Dexter's own ghost guide, Harry. He takes a more active role than Harry, though. Evil Mentor: To Travis, whom he encourages and disciplines.

characters.name: Steve Dorsey
characters.description: Steve Dorsey was a frequent poster on Professor Gellar's website, under the nameDoomsday_Adam. He and his wife, Beth Dorsey, are taken in as Travis Marshall's disciples, and they aided in the death of Holly Benson aboard Peter Grant's yacht. Ascended Fanboy: Started out as a fanatic posting videos on Gellar's blog, then became a disciple to the real Doomsday Killer. The Fundamentalist: Willing to die for Travis' religious cause. Unholy Matrimony: With Beth Dorsey, a fellow dangerous cultist. We Hardly Knew Ye: His appearance is brief before dying.

characters.name: Beth Dorsey
characters.description: Beth Dorsey was married to Steve Dorsey who was a frequent poster on Professor Gellar's website, under the nameDoomsday_Adam. She and her husband, Steve Dorsey, are taken in as Travis Marshall's disciples, and they aided in the death of Holly Benson. Blood from the Mouth: She spews it after getting trapped in a room with deadly gas. The Fundamentalist: Willing to die for Travis' religious cause. Suicide Attack: Attempted on Miami Metro, but failed. Unholy Matrimony: With her husband Steve, a fellow dangerous cultist.

characters.name: Isaak Sirko
characters.description: A high-ranking member of the Ukrainian Mob who comes to Miami to survey his business interests there and avenge the loss of one of his most loyal subordinates. He and MarieLaGuertaserve as theprincipal antagonistsin Season 7. Affably Evil: Incredibly polite and charming most of the time. Steers towardsFaux Affably Evilwhen he starts to rack up the body count, as when he politely threatens to drill a guy's eyes in and then kills him anyway or rams a screwdriver inside a guy's eye while soothing him. He evenlampshadeshis status in a discussion with Nadia the stripper. Alas, Poor Villain:Even Dexter feels sorry for him in his final moments alive, and he gets one of the most tearjerking sendoffs on the entire show. Anyone Can Die: A notable example in that unlike the average big bad, he kicks the bucket well before the season finale. Badass in a Nice Suit: Always dressed well.

characters.name: George Novikov
characters.description: The manager of Isaak's US strip clubs. Alcohol-Induced Idiocy: He drunkenly threatens Quinn and Nadia with a gun. Asshole Victim: Is such a scumbag that no one cares when Quinn guns him down. Bad Boss: He treats his strippers like cattle and has no problem offering up his employees to die. Big Bad Wannabe: He's not entirely pleased when Isaak, the bigger fish, comes to America and casually orders him about. He eventually shoots Isaak, with a view to one day taking his place.

characters.name: Jurg Yeliashkevych
characters.description: Isaak's bodyguard and aide. Bald of Evil: He's coolly professional in his work, which includes kidnapping Hannah. The Dragon: He's Isaak's bodyguard and stays by his side. The Quiet One: He doesn't speak unless he's spoken to, and is pretty terse with Hannah. The Stoic: He rarely changes his expression.

characters.name: Nadia (Nadezhda)
characters.description: A stripper and prostitute who works in George Novikov's bar. She enters a romantic relationship with Quinn. But Now I Must Go: After George dies, she leaves Miami and Quinn. Hooker with a Heart of Gold: A hooker, but is an extremely lovable and endearing person. Morality Pet: For Quinn, considering his numerous levels in jerkass in season 6. Nice Girl: She is an honest and sweet person.

characters.name: Viktor Baskov
characters.description: A Ukrainian gangster who killed a stripper andMike Anderson. Asshole Victim: He impulsively killed a stripper andMike Anderson. Badass Boast: His first attempt to get Dexter to stop killing him by saying that he has powerful friends. Dexter responds by saying he heard that before. Buy Them Off: When histhreat of powerful friendsfails to dissuade Dexter, Viktor remarks that he can get Dexter a lot of money. That attempt fails as well. Defiant to the End: When faced with Dexter, he's angry and shows no fear.

characters.name: Oleg Mickic
characters.description: An assassin for the Koshka Brotherhood. Affably Evil: He doesn't want to kill Isaak, and is pretty well-mannered. He just has a job to do. The Dreaded: Isaak notes him as one of the best. Even Bad Men Love Their Mamas: He has an ill mother, who he briefly speaks of with some resigned sadness. Friendly Enemy: To Isaak, who politely inquires about his mother.

characters.name: Benjamin Caffrey
characters.description: An assassin for the Koshka Brotherhood. The Dreaded: Isaak notes that he's one of the best. Professional Killer: He's hired by the Koshkas to take out Isaak. Scary Black Man: Being aProfessional Killermeans you tend to be pretty scary.

characters.name: Angela Bishop
characters.description: Chief of the Iron Lake police and Dexter's girlfriend. Da Chief: Angela is the chief of the Iron Lake Police Department… which in a small town consists of herself, a secretary, and two other officers. Expy: A tall, attractive cop who is also really good at her job and has a bit of a foul mouth. She is essentially a kinder Deb.Ultimately subverted when she is a thorough professional and arrests Dexter after finding out he is a serial killer. Fair Cop: She’s the stunning chief of police. Hero Antagonist: After she finds out who "Jim" really is, she starts digging further and even uncovers that he is the Bay Harbor Butcher.

characters.name: Audrey Bishop
characters.description: Angela's adopted daughter. Child of Two Worlds: Audrey tells Harrison that due to having a birth mother who was White and her dad partly Seneca, she never felt fully part of either community. Happily Adopted: Audrey was adopted by Angela when her birth mother abandoned her. She's a loving, dedicated mother to her, and Audrey seems happy with her life (at least insofar as any teen is). Though they butt heads, she still very much considers Angela her real mom and loves her as such. Jerk with a Heart of Gold: She acts a little bratty sometimes, but genuinely loves and considers Angela to be her actual mother andsaves Harrison's life after he overdoses on fentanyl.

characters.name: Matt Caldwell
characters.description: Kurt Caldwell’s stockbroker son who was involved in a recent boat accident that killed five people. Asshole Victim:He’s obnoxious enough for Dexter to kill for the first time in a decade. Disproportionate Retribution: His friend Bill reveals that Matt caused the boat accident on purpose while drunk and playing chicken with the owner of of the other boat, deliberately ramming him even after the man gave up and turned away just because Matt hated him over losing half a million over a business they were involved in. Ephebophile: As if being an immature murderous scumbag wasn't enough, he also slept with Becca, a high school student. Foil: To Harrison. They are both the son of a serial killer (or in Harrison’s case, two), have aNever My Faultattitude because of their bad childhoods, and are willing to lie to get away with doing bad things. Matt is basically what Harrison will become if he stays on his dark path.

characters.name: Kurt Caldwell
characters.description: Matt's father and a very influential figure in Iron Lake. Abusive Parents: Kurt's father was a horribleDomestic Abuserwho would beat up female hitchhikers or runaways after Kurt's mother left him. Kurt lived in constant fear that his father would turn his anger on him. Asshole Victim:Dexter kills him in Episode 9 ofNew Blood. Kurt also earns the dubious honor of being the first kill that Dexter did in front of his son, Harrison. Big Bad:The main villain ofDexter New Bloodas the maskedSerial Killerwho's hunting young women, which forms the main mystery of the season. Bitch in Sheep's Clothing:He’s presented as a polite and likable person who’s just looking for his son. But then it’s revealed that he’s a serial killer who likes to trap runaway single women and then release them only tosnipe them while they are running away.

characters.name: Sergeant Logan
characters.description: A Father to His Men: He is a wrestling coach at the high school and cares deeply about the kids he teaches to the point that whenHarrison overdoses on fentanyl, he ispissedand even successfully hunts down the drug dealers. Horrible Judge of Character: Out of everyone at the police station, Logan is the most willing to defend Matt when people question his actions. He genuinely believes that Matt is a “good guy”, despite all the evidence to the contrary. He also doesn’t see that his wrestling team is full of obnoxious bullies. Or that Dexter has ulterior motives for various interactions with him. Neck Snap:How Dexter kills him while Logan was going for his gun. Notable for this being Dexter's first completely intentional murder of an unambiguously good and nice person. Nice Guy: Friendly, polite, and genuinely concerned for others.

characters.name: Jasper Hodge
characters.description: A local drug dealer who earns Dexter's ire. Asshole Victim: A drug dealingJerkasswho indirectly killed at least eighteen people by giving them overdoses of fentanyl. Hypocrite: Like many drug dealers he views addicts with contempt but has no problem enabling their addictions to make money. Indirect Serial Killer: He doesn't actually kill anyone himself but his negligence when it comes to making drugs results in the deaths of over a dozen people. It's Personal: Dexter decides to go after him afterHarrison overdoses on pills Jasper sold.

characters.name: Edward Olsen
characters.description: A local billionaire and oil magnate. Bitch in Sheep's Clothing: Presents a friendly face, but is a ruthless businessman who couldn't care less about others. HisPet the Dogmoments are clearly PR moves. Hate Sink: He has next to no bearing on the plot, simply existing to be aCorrupt Corporate Executivewho can be despised (and aRed Herringto the identity of the Runaway Killer). His only contribution is lending his personal helicopter to contribute to the search for Matt. Red Herring: Appears to be a suspect for the white-masked killer. OnceKurtis revealed to be so, he essentially disappears from the plot.

characters.name: Tess Silvera
characters.description: A teacher at Iron Lake High School and also the bartender. Nice Girl: She seems to be the friendliest person in this quaint town. Out of Focus: Shows up a few times, but isn't really a major character and has little impact on the plot.

characters.name: Molly Park
characters.description: ATrue Crimejournalist who runs her own podcast,Merry Fucking Kill. Bad Influencer: A variety. She's a podcaster who is rude, dismissive about her cases, cruel about the innocent victims involved, and kind of an idiot. Be Careful What You Wish For:Her obsession with serial killers led to her getting murdered by one. Cheated Death, Died Anyway:Dexter saves Molly from Kurt and takes her to safety, but then he apparently tracked her down and murdered her in between anyway. Crouching Moron, Hidden Badass: Despite her vapid and clout-chasing personality, she does turn out to be surprisingly competent at collecting information and online detective work when she puts her mind to it, surprising even Angela with what she and her connections were able to find.

characters.name: Chloe
characters.description: A runaway girl who Kurt ends up helping find some work in Iron Lake. Do Not Go Gentle: She absolutely refuses to die the way Kurt wants, much to his frustration. After trying multiple ways to escape, she refuses to run so that Kurt can shoot her in the back, and charges him instead. Fan Disservice: Her face after being shot counts as one. Also applies to her stripping scene since Kurt is made very uncomfortable, and since the viewers know she's doing it to try and appease him since she assumes he's preying on her, showing off her breasts ends up being pretty uncomfortable for them too. Gory Discretion Shot: Averted — viewers are given a clear view of her after she's shot, to make Kurt's terror even more apparent. Hidden Buxom: Since the town is cold and she doesn't have a consistent place to stay, she dressed practically with a sweater and a bulky jacket over it. Once she's alone in Kurt's cabin and takes the jacket off, it's shown that her chest is ample enough. Confirmed when she begins stripping in front of the camera.

characters.name: Aaron Spencer
characters.description: Abusive Parents:Once he believes his son Nicky isn't biologically his, he, with only mild hesitation, decides to abduct him and cut off his finger, he then later tries to drown him. Affair? Blame the Bastard!:At least, he believes Nicky isn't his. As revenge for his ex-wife cheating on him, he kidnaps, mutilates, and attempts to kill him. Big Bad Ensemble: WithBrian MoserinOriginal SinSeason 1. Da Chief: He's in charge of Miami Metro Homicide. Evil All Along:He kidnapped and murdered a judge's son as well as his own son, then planted evidence to stage a raid on a drug cartel and kill some of them.

characters.name: Tanya Martin
characters.description: Canon Foreigner: She didn't appear in neither the books nor the original series. Casting Gag: After the original series castJulie Benz, also known as Darla in theBuffyverse, as Rita,Original Singets Buffy herself. Dumb Blonde: Inverted. You don't get to be head of Forensics by being stupid. Remember the New Guy?: She had a close working relationship with many characters from the original series, including mentoring Dexter himself in forensics, yet was never mentioned once in the original series. The Gambling Addict: Her game of choice is betting on horse-races.

characters.name: Bobby Watt
characters.description: Black Best Friend: Is one to Harry and they have been partners since at least the 70s. Harry even named him as Deb’s godfather. Black Guy Dies First: Subverted. He's shot during the raid at the end of episode 8, and is in critical condition after that. Since he's exclusive to the prequel, it's implied he won't make it. He ends up surviving, with his ultimate fate unknown. By-the-Book Cop: He's Harry's partner and a very dedicated, by-the-book police officer. Doomed by Canon: Subverted. Despite not appearing in the original series at any point, as well as getting shot during episode 8, Bobby survives the events ofOriginal Sin. Secret-Keeper:Alongside Harry and Camilla Figg, he is one of the few people that knows about Dexter’s origins.

characters.name: Clark Sanders
characters.description: Black Best Friend: Serves as one to Dexter, sort of being what Angel Batista would become to him in the original series. Closet Gay: Dexter discovers this about him when bumps into him at a gay bar when they are off work. Dark and Troubled Past: He became a cop and hopes to become a detective one day because his brother got shot and killed in front of their home.

characters.name: Tony Ferrer
characters.description: Asshole Victim: A brutal loan shark and killer, Handsome Tony is evidently missed by few when he disappears. Boom, Headshot!: Threatens people with these, including Dexter. Loan Shark: His usual clientele are poor Cuban immigrants, whom he charges high interest rates with little time to pay them back, and kills them when they can't. Off with His Head!: Dexter decapitates him with a machete as part of his "experimenting" as a budding serial killer. Serial Killer: Killed at least three of the people he lent money to.

characters.name: Anthony "Mad Dog" Moretti
characters.description: Asshole Victim: While not in the way he intended, Dexter rids the world of a violent assassin. Deadly Euphemism: Has a conversation with Dexter about his work in "foreclosures". From Camouflage to Criminal: He had previously served in the U.S. Navy before becoming a Mob Hitman. Look Both Ways: Gets splattered by a truck when fleeing from Dexter. Would Hurt a Child: He tells Dexter he would be willing to"foreclose on"children, although it's unclear if he actually did.

characters.name: Levi Reed
characters.description: Asshole Victim: This absolutely psychotic monster murdered multiple families for little more than kicks. For the Evulz: He admits on the table that he went out of his way to kill the people he was robbing just for fun. Karma Houdini: Due to Harry dismissing a witness improperly, Reed getsOff on a Technicality. Thankfully subverted when Harry gives Dexter thego ahead to kill him. Karmic Death: Killed in the home of the family he murdered. "Not So Different" Remark: He's observant enough to point out that both he and Dexter are motivated by an urge to kill.

characters.name: Prater
characters.description: A billionaire venture capitalist and serial killer obsessive. Benevolent Boss: He is very kind to his employees and acts as a fatherly figure to them. He takes care to know their names, their histories, and their problems so he can help with them.Though we later learn that this is a façade and he actually does all of this to manipulate those around him into doing his bidding. He even kept evidence of his most loyal enforcer Charley as a fail-safe in case she ever tries to leave his employ. Big Bad: He is theArc Villainfor Season 1 ofResurrection, being the chairman of the Serial Killer Society that Dexter has infiltrated, where he bankrolled active Serial killers in exchange for trophies and stories. He mostly stands in the background as Dexter picks off the serial killers one by one.But he firmly cements himself in this role once he finds out Dexter's true identity and kills his long-time friend Batista with Dexter dedicating himself to bring him down once and for all. Bitch in Sheep's Clothing:He only puts on a kind face to his employees because it's beneficial to him. He doesn't actually care about them insofar as they are useful to his needs. In private he is more than happy to force those beneath him into committing horrible actions on his behalf. Collector of the Strange: His main hobby is collecting mementos from the most notorious serial killers and mass murderers in history, and a requirement to join his society is to have something to his collection. Items include John Wayne Gacy's clown outfit, Jeffrey Dahmer's refrigerator, a knife and Mother's Day card from Edmund Kemper, William Suff's socks, William Bonin's license plates, one of the Zodiac Killer's maps and cyphers, Donald Henry Gaskins' prison uniform, the hook used by the New York Ripper, the driver's seat from Ted Bundy's car, a gold record that belonged to Wayne Williams, Harold Shipman's glasses and syringe case, Charles Manson's guitar, and a skull helmet from someone known only as "the Flight

characters.name: Charley
characters.description: Prater's head of security and personal fixer. Actor Allusion: In a tone that screamsTranquil Fury, she mentions she has "unfinished business" with Praterafter she lays out her terms to Dexter and Harrison before going on to betray her boss and leave his employ. Cassandra Truth: She tries to warn Prater Red is suspicious and is completely right that "Red"provoked Gareth to kill him.Prater angrily dresses her down for questioning their "friend's" loyalty. Consummate Professional: Charley doesn't concern herself with morality or ethics. She does her job, no more or less. She is ruthlessly efficient. Corrupted Character Copy: Of Uma Thurman'sothernotableAction Girlrole -The Bride, AKABeatrix Kiddo. Both are hardened, well-trained assassins loyal to powerful men who perform dirty work for money and have names related to old-timey cartoon characters, but unlike The Bride who ended up in a relationship with her boss Bill and abandoned him once she realized she had a conscience and couldn't allow their child to be born into a life of crime, Charley has a strictly professional relationship with Prater, and only works for him as a means to provide for her sick mother, and will do absolutely anything her job requires of her so long as there is trust between her and her employer and her needs can be provided for.

characters.name: In General
characters.description: Affably Evil: Most of the serial killers Dexter meets are friendly, cheerful company, acting completely normal in general. This also appears to be genuine. Always a Bigger Fish: Prater's killer group may be vicious and prolific but they do not hold a candle toThe Bay Harbor Butcher. Asshole Victim: They are all sadistic and brutal serial killers who show zero remorse for killing innocent people. They end up being targeted by The Bay Harbor Butcher for this reason. Creepy Souvenir: Each of them has their own collection of trophies that they obtain from their victims. For example, Rapunzel collects the cut off ponytails of their quarry, Gemini takes pictures of their kills, Lady Vengeance keeps various trinkets, and the appropriately named the Tattoo Collector accumulate an assortment oftattooed human skins.They do sell some of their trophies to Prater so that he may add them to his collection of serial killer memorabilia. Dwindling Party: Naturally, they are picked off one-by-one mostly due to the results of Dexter's actions. By the end of the first season ofResurrection,only Al Walker remains at large out of all the main guests. However, Dexter intends to hunt him down along with several other unseen members among Prater's killers. Additionally, Claudette finds Prater's file on The New York Ripper which puts them in a compromising position.

characters.name: Lady Vengeance
characters.description: A sommelier and serial killer who targets sexual predators. Ax-Crazy:Kills indiscriminately when she feels like it. Bait the Dog:Mia seems to be like Dexter, a killer with a code taking out rapists and sexual predators. It turns out that while she did start that way, she does not have much of a code at all. She kills when she feels like it and does not care if innocents die. Broken Pedestal: Dexter befriends Mia, one of the serial killers in Leon Prater's group, due to her going after sexual predators like how Dexter goes after murderers. It looks like she would end up being a love interest for Dexter, only for the relationship to go sour whenshe reveals that she goes afteranyman, whether or not they're innocent, and that onlysomeof them are sexual predators. Dexter, who tries to avoid harming innocent people, is disgusted, stops Mia from going after a rideshare driver using his alias' M.O., and ends up calling the police on her and framing her for Ryan the rapist's murder after realizing that murdering two killers in a short timespan would alert Prater's group. Cold-Blooded Torture: Speaks about putting lye in her victim's corneas and has a lot of sharp tools with her, which show that she clearly enjoys torturing her victims to death.

characters.name: Red
characters.description: A New York-based serial killer who targets cabbies. Dead Person Impersonation: After killing the Dark Passenger AKA Ronald "Red" Schmidt, Dexter steals the deceased killer's invite to Leon Prater's secret "Serial Killer Party". It helps that he and Schmidt share a physical resemblance and the latter was very secretive about his identity, making it that much easier to impersonate him. It almost fails when Dexter discovers that he needs Schmidt's fingerprint to access the meeting in the first placeafterhe just chucked his body parts into an oven. Fortunately,he's able to save the arm, which isn't too badly burnt to make the print useless. Evil Counterpart: To Dexter as they both share a passing physical resemblance to each other and identify as "The Dark Passenger." Schmidt's modus operandi of putting a garrote over a driver's neck while sitting in back seat of the car is an obviousCall-Backto how Dexter threaten his first onscreen victim, Father Mike Donovan, to drive to the prepared kill room. Also, Dexter and Schmidt were greatly influenced by their relationship with their fathers that resulted in them becoming the killers they are today. Thanks to their similarities, Dexter is able to pass off as Red while preforming aDead Person Impersonationto infiltrate Prater's serial killer gatherings. Evil Vegetarian: When Dexter has dinner with Prater and the other serial killers while impersonating Red, Prater gives him a plate of vegetables and states that Charley found out Red was vegan from the food and cookbooks in his apartment. Freudian Excuse Is No Excuse: He claims he targets Rideshare drivers because the prevalence of such companies ruined the life of Red's father and caused his suicide. Dexter informs him that this is complete garbage as an excuse, as he's just targeting innocent men barely one step from poverty working to provide for their loved ones.

characters.name: The Canton Clubber
characters.description: A serial killer who uses a bat in his murders. Alliterative Name: Not his real name, but his moniker of theCantonClubber. Asshole Victim: Even though he went against Prater and Charley, he was still a serial killer, so no tears were shed when he was killed by Charley. Batter Up!: He bludgeons people with a spiked baseball bat. He ends up unceremoniously ousted from the group for attempting to blackmail everyone and killed with his own bat after pissing off Charley. Bullying a Dragon: Isdumb enoughto try blackmailing Prater into handing over even more money, threatening to go to the police if he doesn't comply. Charley — who has confiscated the Clubber's signature spiked baseball bat, which she happens to be holding, for Prater's collection — points out that he would just incriminate himself as a serial killer if he did that, and when he refuses to let the matter go, she beats him to death there and then.

characters.name: The Tattoo Collector
characters.description: A serial killer who takes tattoos as trophies. Corrupted Character Copy: OfBarney Stinson. Unlike Barney who has some legitimate charm, Lowell comes across as creepy and off-putting. Dead Star Walking:Neil Patrick Harris was heavily promoted as a guest star. His character only lasts for one episode in the series. Deadly Doctor: He is an anesthesiologist in his everyday life, and uses this expertise in his kills. He carries a canister of anesthesia with a mask to subdue his victims, and cuts their skin with surgical precision to achieve his "skins". Face Death with Dignity:When Dexter catches Lowell, the latter doesn't beg for his life and just asks Dexter to finish him off quickly. He doesn't even show fear when it becomes clear he won't even have the chance to be unconscious when he gets killed. Slightly subverted when Dexter reveals that he is the Bay Harbor Butcher.

characters.name: Rapunzel
characters.description: A serial killer who cuts off ponytails. Affably Evil: He's a jovial family man who rationalizes his murderous impulses as essential to maintaining his home life. Afraid of Blood: Despite being a serial killer, he cannot stand the sight of blood. His kills are relatively bloodless affairs since he's not chopping heads off or disemboweling anyone: he just strangles his victims and cuts off their hair after they're dead. Big Fun: A heavyset and gregarious man. Even Evil Has Standards: When Gareth brags about himself, Al looks away and frowns, showing even he doesn't like the boasting.

characters.name: Gemini
characters.description: A serial killer who takes polaroid pictures of his victims, whom he kills in pairs. Affably Evil: Averted, Gareth is openly rude to just about everyone and doesn't even bother pretending to be polite. Attention Whore: Gareth's kills are very public, always moving corpses and posing them together. He relishes the fame his moniker has given him. Creepy Twins:It turns out there aretwoGemini Killers, when Gareth shows up to Prater's tarmac after Dexter has disposed of Gareth's identical twin. Criminal Mind Games: Gareth writes letters to the police and media to attract more attention to himself, giving them his self-chosen nickname of "Gemini". Just like howthe Zodiac killerleft coded messages for the police.

characters.name: The New York Ripper
characters.description: A serial killer who disemboweled their victims and while they presumably have stopped killing, they keep calling their victim's loved ones to torment them about the deaths. Crowbar Combatant: They used a crowbar (And as Dexter notes, something longer like a manhole key) on their victims. The crowbar itself is part of Prater's collection. The Ghost: Has not been seen, but their presence still haunts New York despite having stopped killing and the killer was presumably a former guest of Prater's parties as their murder weapon is in his vault.And by the end of Season 1, he never appears at all, but the police have a name. Karma Houdini Warranty: The end of the season hasWallace find Prater's file with the Ripper's real name: Don Framt. Implying she's finally about to take him down. Red Baron: "The New York Ripper".

characters.name: Detective Claudette Wallace
characters.description: A New York City homicide detective who starts to become aware of Dexter and his son after investigating the murder of Ryan Foster. Arbitrary Skepticism: Despite being a homicide detective, she finds Angel Batista's claims that Dexter is the Bay Harbor Butcher flimsy, even when he brings her to Dexter's almost kill room. Justified as he has no concrete evidence to prove it. Brainy Brunette: Claudette Wallace is a highly intelligent NYPD homicide detective with dark brown hair. Bunny-Ears Lawyer: She appears to have some form of autism and does most of her work while wearing headphones playing her favorite song ("Stayin' Alive" byThe Bee Gees), but she has a highly analytical mind that makes her a very good investigator. Character Signature Song: She's very fond ofStayin' Aliveby The Bee Gees. To the point where she plays it while thinking during her investigations..

characters.name: Detective Melvin Olivia
characters.description: Detective Wallace's partner. Arbitrary Skepticism: Like Wallace, he has a hard time believing Angel Batista's claims that Dexter is the Bay Harbor Butcher without evidence. Cloudcuckoolander's Minder: He's not as put off by Wallace's eccentricities, indicating this relationship. Flat Character: He's not got much characterization outside of being Wallace's more straightlaced partner.

characters.name: Blessing Kamara
characters.description: AUrCardriver Dexter befriends when arriving in New York. Dark and Troubled Past: He was aChild Soldierin the Sierra Leone Civil War, because he had been forced into this by the Revolutionary United Front rebels. His mother found and saved him before they went to the US. Family Man: Has a very good relationship with his whole family, even extending that relationship to Dexter and Harrison, both of whom he'd only just recently met. Momma's Boy: Loves his mother dearly. When her health deteriorates, he insists on rushing her to hospital despite her wishes to be among family when she passes. When she does pass, he's inconsolable and can barely get through a speech without breaking down. Given she rescued him from a dangerous life as a child soldier, you can understand why. Morality Chain: He serves as this to Dexter who has becomeThe Atonerafter surviving his son shooting him and arriving in New York. While Dexter has already done some self-reflection on how destructive his murderous ways are, it would be the presence of Blessing and his family that brings out his once-lost humanity. He kills Red and then the rest of Prater's Serial Killer Society not to satisfy his own murderous urges but to keep them from hurting good people like Blessing and his family.

characters.name: Elsa Rivera
characters.description: A friend of Harrison who also works at the Empire Hotel. Has a young son, Dante. Expy: Being a single mother working at a hotel and interacting with Harrison a lot, she shares a lot of similarities with Rita. Struggling Single Mother: She works at the hotel to provide for her son Dante, who was born as a result of a one-night stand.

characters.name: Lance Thomas
characters.description: Another friend of Harrison who also works at the Empire Hotel. Black Best Friend: Serves as one to Harrison. The Stoner: He always seems to have a joint on his person, sometimes offering others a smoke. Harrison uses this as a way to get a security guard out of the way to Prater's penthouse.

characters.name: Stefan Pike
characters.description: The Empire Hotel's manager and Harrison's boss. Mean Boss: Downplayed. He seems to be as about as officious as you'd expect a hotel manager to be. He never seems to single out Harrison even when Harrison is outed for staying in empty hotel rooms. Schedule Fanatic: He is very strict. "On time is late."

characters.name: Ryan Foster
characters.description: A guest at the hotel where Harrison works who tries to assault Shauna, a guest Harrison had befriended, awakening Harrison's violent urges. Asshole Victim: Was about to rape a woman hedrugged with Rohypnolbefore taking her into his room. His comments imply he's aSerial Rapist, which Dexter later confirms from reading news reports on his acquittals in the past for previous rape charges. Lampshades by Batista who calls him an asshole.Dexter later takes advantage of this fact by framing him as a victim of Lady Vengeance. Attempted Rape: He drags a drunken woman up to his room with the intention of having sex with her. Harrison tries to ignore it, until he hears Shauna saying "no", at which point he runs in and beats Ryan up. Bullying a Dragon: Harrison beats him up very badly when he catches him trying to rape Shauna. So naturally, right when Harrison's about to walk away, he decides to taunt him about how he's gonna do it again. Hate Sink: He's asmugsadisticSerial Rapistwho gloats to Harrison that there will always be more women to rape. The story makes it very clear the audience is not supposed to like him.

characters.name: Cooper Morris
characters.description: The man who killed Leon Prater's parents. Car Fu: Kills his victims with his car while trying to frame them as drunk hit-and-run accidents. Lack of Empathy: Said he felt no remorse for killing Prater's parents. Posthumous Character: He was already dead before the series began. Serial Killer:Claims to have killed before he killed Prater's parentsand that their deaths were not an accident.

characters.name: Gigi
characters.description: A sophomore at the college Harrison takes an interest in. Career-Ending Injury: Before it can evenbegin. Gigi's arm is in a cast when Harrison first meets her. After some time with him, she reveals the nerve damage in the arm may risk her chances of becoming a detective that she's wanted to become. Catchphrase: She ends an implausible fact about herself with "I'm fucking with you." Harrison quickly catches on to this. Love Interest: For Harrison. The two even sleep together after going to a party and engage in further hanky-panky afterwards. Oh, Crap!:Played for Laughs, Gigi has this reaction when she realizes she made an obnoxious dirty joke to Dexter over the phone while having sex with Harrison. In her defense she thought it was Batista, who had been pestering Harrison the entire season.

characters.name: Vinny
characters.description: Elsa's abusive landlord. Cranky Landlord: Embodies all the classic traits of one - aggressive, unsympathetic, and quick to threaten eviction over late rent payments. Dirty Coward: Acts like an intimidating asshole for most of his screentime, then when placed on a kill table, he immediately screams, bitches, and pleads for his life, Dexter can see just how pathetic Vinny really is. Fat Bastard: He's an overweight landlord who doesn't care about his tenants' well-being. A Lighter Shade of Black: He may be a white collar criminal who rents out mold-infested apartments and Dexter discovers he also evicted some tenants from his properties who later died homeless, but it's too circumstantial. Dexter only goes after unambiguous murderers like the sadistic killers in Prater's group.
